Name: Baanah, Son of Rimmon
Summary: Baanah, son of Rimmon the Beerothite and a captain of Ish-bosheth's bands, murdered Ish-bosheth in his bed at noon with his brother Rechab and carried his head to David, expecting reward. David had both brothers executed.
KeyStory: Baanah murdered his own king for a reward and was executed for it the same day.
RelatedPeople: Ish-bosheth, Son of Saul; Rechab, Son of Rimmon; King David
LifeLesson: A brother in murder is a brother in judgment.
